chapterTitle: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind

acts.actTitle: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind
acts.description: After arriving on the shores of Teyvat, the Traveler meets Paimon and journeys to the city of Mondstadt, encountering Stormterror and the Knights of Favonius.
The Traveler assists the bard Venti in retrieving the Holy Lyre der Himmel from the Knights' cathedral and uncovering the true nature of Dvalin's corruption.
quests: State of the Holy Lyre der Himmel

acts.actTitle: Song of the Dragon and Freedom
acts.description: Together with Diluc, Jean, and Venti, the Traveler breaches the storm barrier of Old Mondstadt to purify Stormterror and confront the Fatui Harbinger Signora.
The Traveler visits Liyue Harbor during the Rite of Descension, witnessing the assassination of Rex Lapis and seeking refuge among the Adepti in Jueyun Karst.
Partnering with the mysterious consultant Zhongli and Childe of the Fatui, the Traveler prepares the funeral rites for Rex Lapis across the vibrant landscapes of Liyue.
The conflict between the Fatui, Adepti, and Liyue Qixing reaches its zenith as Osial, Overlord of the Vortex, is unleashed upon the harbor.
The Traveler meets the mysterious wanderer Dainsleif and begins tracking the clandestine movements of the Abyss Order across Mondstadt.
Venturing into an inverted statue domain, the Traveler faces the Abyss Herald and comes face-to-face with their lost sibling.

Though you have returned from the darkness of that cave into the light, the pain of parting remains in your heart.
What are the gods' motives? Where did your sibling go? Where may the truth of this world be found?
Whatever the case may be, you are resolved to continue onward — to "reach the end of your journey."

acts.actTitle: The Immovable God and the Eternal Euthymia
acts.description: Upon reaching Ritou, the Traveler navigates the isolationist Sakoku Decree, meets the Kamisato Clan, and joins the struggle against the Vision Hunt Decree.
quests: A Swordmaster's Path Is Paved With Broken Blades
A Flower Blooms in a Prison

acts.description: The Traveler flees the Tenryou Commission to Watatsumi Island, uniting with General Gorou and Sangonomiya Kokomi's resistance army on the frontlines of Kannazuka.
quests: In the Name of the Resistance

acts.description: With the aid of Yae Miko, the Traveler infiltrates Tenshukaku, challenges Signora to a duel before the throne, and enters the Plane of Euthymia to change the Raiden Shogun's eternal path.
quests: Those Who Yearn for the Gods' Gaze

acts.description:
Divine calamity descended upon the ancient realm,
And within the deep darkness, a sorrowful reunion awaits.
We can no longer discern the roaring words of the guardians,
—Until the requiem resounds in the Abyss.
quests: In the Depths, an Unexpected Reunion

chapterTitle: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana

acts.actTitle: Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark
acts.description: Entering Sumeru through the rainforest, the Traveler experiences hallucination induced by spirit incense and meets Forest Watcher Tighnari before visiting Sumeru City.
quests: The Trail of the God of Wisdom

acts.actTitle: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings
acts.description: Trapped in the endless Samsara dream cycle of the Sabzeruz Festival, the Traveler and Nahida solve the Akasha mystery to celebrate Nilou's dance of devotion.
quests: The Coming of the Sabzeruz Festival
The Arrival of the Sabzeruz Festival
The Continuation of the Sabzeruz Festival
The Samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival
The Causality of the Sabzeruz Festival
The Empty Illusions of the Sabzeruz Festival
The End of the Sabzeruz Festival

acts.description:
"The world as it is, and all that is in it — it is but a dream, empty and full of lies."
The Sabzeruz Festival samsara finally comes to an end.
The path to saving the god lies within the desert stars.
"I am the lord of the scarlet soil. My deeds are world-renowned, and even the strong kneel before me!"
quests: The Gaze From a Certain God

acts.actTitle: King Deshret and the Three Magi
acts.description: Venturing into the Great Red Sand desert, the party unearths the ancient truth of King Deshret's sacrifice and gains the alliance of the desert Eremites.

acts.actTitle: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
acts.description:
"Rukkhadevata formed the bones and flowing blood, and Kusanali the innards and beating heart. Thrice holy and sacred their goodness and grace, worthy of worship, of praise, of laud, of record."
"In those days, Akasha ran not, the ashes of calamity had settled, and the past had become history."
This is the tale of "Buer's" First Sage.|Act Announcement
quests: Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies

acts.description:
This world is filled with those who would oppose fate, while the one who understands fate smiles faintly down upon them.
If the one who weaves fate may be born here, then let the one who witnesses fate see it all.
The Traveler arrives in the Court of Fontaine, attends a magic show by Lyney and Lynette at the Opera Epiclese, and takes the stand as defense attorney.
quests: The City of Rains and Remembrance
Lies Cast Shadows Under Gathered Lights

acts.actTitle: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
acts.description: Investigating the serial disappearances of young women with Navia and the Spina di Rosula, the Traveler uncovers the truth of the Primordial Sea water.
quests: Like the Faint Moonlight of Yesteryear
The Truth, Lost With the Rain
When All Return to the Waters

acts.actTitle: To the Stars Shining in the Depths
acts.description: The Traveler is sentenced to the underwater Fortress of Meropide as an undercover operative for Chief Justice Neuvillette to investigate the Forbidden Zone.
quests: The Proscribed, Hidden in Plain Sight

acts.description: As the Primordial Sea ruptures the foundation of the Fortress, Wriothesley and Neuvillette seal the floodgate while the Fatui Harbinger Arlecchino makes her move.
The prophecy comes to pass: the trial of the Hydro Archon commences, the All-Devouring Narwhal rises, and Focalors' five-hundred-year grand masquerade concludes.
quests: The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur

acts.description:
After listening to the bedtime story that day, all the hilichurls had a dream.
The young soul waved goodbye, and the people and sun slept together warmly.

acts.actTitle: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
acts.description: The Traveler enters the volcanic lands of Natlan, bonded with a Saurian companion, and competes in the Sacred Pilgrimage alongside Kachina and Mualani.
quests: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame (Quest)

acts.actTitle: Black Stone Under a White Stone
acts.description: Venturing into the Night Kingdom to rescue fallen warriors, the Traveler witnesses the abyss encroaching upon the Sacred Flame of the Stadium.
Investigating the Masters of the Night-Wind tribe with Xilonen and Citlali to fortify the Wayob barriers against the abyssal invasion.
quests: The Flickering Light Splits in Twain

acts.description: The six tribes of Natlan unite as Captain Capitano and the Fatui join forces with Archon Mavuika to defend the Stadium from total collapse.
quests: As One We Watch the Setting Sun

acts.description: A profound interlude between the tribal armies preparing the defense of the Sacred Flame before the descent into the Night Kingdom.

The path of war approaches its end, all eyes fixed upon the hero's back.
The crushing burden of "fate" and "rules" weighs heavy upon this place, making each step forward a staggering effort.
Yet the sun has proclaimed its intention — to burn away both shackles and the self, and in their place, usher in a new chapter for humankind...
quests: As the Sun Rises and Sets

acts.actTitle: A Space and Time for You
acts.description:
The end of a journey is also its beginning. Time is meaningless.
You and I are clearly looking at the same view. Space is meaningless.
...Until your destiny and mine collide, and twine all those threads together.
quests: A Space and Time Without You

acts.description:
Moonlight paves the path ahead, and a new journey is about to unfold. Yet before you cross the sea to Nod-Krai, an unexpected visitor arrives in Natlan...
All things are but wayfarers in this world — no place is their home. A thousand years pass, yet all remain transient.

acts.actTitle: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
acts.description:
This is where the moon rises — an "elysium" for adventurers.
The moon's radiance is distant, the snow-ashen groves are lush, and secrets echo throughout the land like an ancient song.
Go forth now and listen to the melody beneath the moonlight.
Uncovering the forgotten lore of the Moon Sisters amidst the ancient dust and lamplit ruins.
quests: One There Was, Who Hunted the Moon

acts.description:
The howling coyotes seek the moon's fading trail, while shadows hang heavy upon every heart.
Ancient memories resurface before our eyes, and the riddles left by history still drive countless souls to struggle onward in the torrent of fate.
The tragic tale of the three lunar palaces and their shattering during the Primordial Cataclysm.
quests: Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion

acts.actTitle: A Nocturne of the Far North
acts.description:
To defy fate, you may flee the clamor of the world and venture into the phantom night.
The moon's veil shrouds the silent river, while tranquil lanterns illuminate the path ahead.
Homeland is always there, calling out to every lost soul.
quests: In the Shifting Light of the Moon

acts.actTitle: Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist
acts.description: Breaking the eternal frost illusion to expose the true mechanism governing Teyvat's lunar cycle.
quests: The Night the Moon Returns Home

acts.actTitle: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
acts.description:
The moon's light dims, obscured by thick clouds gathering across the Nod-Krai sky — clouds shaped by conspiracy...
Where the false and the real intertwine, a battle for the fate of your companions and Nod-Krai has already begun... Will that true moonlight ever return to the land of its home?
quests: Where Our Space and Time Intersect
Tracing the Footsteps of the Past

acts.description: The awakening of the True Moon and the descent of celestial light upon the northern hemisphere.

People describe wisdom in many different ways: an eternal garden, an imperishable monument, an ancient tree that reaches the sky. And from these they extract what they most desire: a flower, a stone, a leaf...
Wisdom also seeps into every dream, for better or for worse, flowing like a stream, projecting itself as the shadow of a tree over every corner of the world.
Thus, the catastrophe that lurks in dreams manifests itself...
Now, it is descending.

acts.actTitle: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
acts.description: The grand synthesis uniting the wisdom of Sumeru, the lunar lineage of Nod-Krai, and the Traveler's celestial nature.

Fierce winds and raging blizzards manifest the bitter cold of the snowland, so relentless that drives many travelers away.
In a place where life ought to fall into slumber, glowing light and monumental legacies pierce through the ice, rising tall and defiant amidst the snowland...
Expose yourself to its will — for those who strive to transcend must never seek survival in the shadow of pity.
quests: Into the Wind, Into the Frigid North

acts.description: Investigating the clandestine activities of the Fatui Harbingers and the phantom legions of the Cryo Archon.

acts.actTitle: White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking
acts.description:
The rampaging monster has fallen, and Tsaritsa Anastasya has returned in triumph to Zapolyarny Palace.
However, with Project Stuzha put on hold, the treacherous curse of death, and the anxious people... Snezhnaya's dawn remains deeply sealed within the swirling snowstorm.
The bitter cold leaves no one who sets foot on the tundra any chance to stop. All they can do is keep moving until the dark clouds veiling the sky finally disperse.
The battle reaches the abyssal foundations beneath Snezhnaya as the Cryo Archon sounds the final horn of defiance.

chapterTitle: The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed

acts.actTitle: The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed
acts.description: Deep within the godless ruins of Khaenri'ah, the Traveler reaches the origin of the Cataclysm and the culmination of their journey.

acts.actTitle: The Crane Returns on the Wind
acts.description:
As news of the Jade Chamber's reconstruction spreads, many merchants flock to Yujing Terrace.
Ningguang's reward raises the curtain on the competition, while dark undercurrents present a different sort of threat.
Will Liyue, now under human rule, withstand the coming tide? Will the one long separated from society find their place among people once more?
All will be revealed when the Jade Chamber rises once more.

The Chasm, which had been sealed off for a long time, is now gradually reopening. The once-abandoned place now sees visitors again.
However, there seem to be other secrets hidden beneath this mysterious area that has existed since ancient times.
For various reasons, people come here in search of answers, as they venture step by step, deep into The Chasm...

Wounded and defeated, The Balladeer has been imprisoned in Sumeru after his duel against the Traveler and the Dendro Archon.
Yet, no one knows how this special prisoner should pay for his many transgressions or even what to do with him after the dust has settled...
quests: The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call

acts.description:
Greatness, created in the moment where miracles met life. Neither mundane knowledge nor earthly compassion could hope to reach that light.
The arrogant slither forth from the darkness, hypocrisy draped in virtue and reason, their gnashing maws devour all — brothers and mothers alike.
